items.abstract: Establishing shared meaning is widely considered the normative, almost ubiquitous trajectory of linguistic interaction, while moments of misalignment are typically viewed as temporary interruptions that individuals attempt to repair. However, it is not uncommon to experience communication breakdowns that actively escalate rather than resolve. This raises a fundamental question: does interaction inherently lead people toward shared meaning, or is semantic alignment a reciprocal, socially contingent process? We conducted four experiments using a novel multiplayer word association task, where participants generated semantic associations while interacting with either human or simulated partners varying in semantic typicality. Our results show that, in general, social interaction motivates individuals to produce more conventional associations to support alignment. However, this tendency depended on partner’s behavior: when interacting with an atypical or difficult-to-align-with partner, individuals actively reduced their own typicality and tendency to match partner’s associations, effectively sacrificing semantic alignment. Such ‘reciprocal misalignment’ persisted even when participants were incentivized to maximize alignment. Our findings suggest that semantic misalignment may reflect a reciprocal, socially-motivated modulation of identity and differentiation, rather than solely a failure of coordination. This work sheds light on the interactional mechanisms underlying interpersonal distancing, communication breakdowns in neurodivergence, and potentially broader patterns of social polarization.
title: Breaking Common Ground through Reciprocal Misalignment

items.abstract: <jats:p>In this work, we used fuzzy inference system to forecast rice production covering the period 2021-2030 in Jigawa state, Nigeria. This is done by designing a fuzzy inference system using MATLAB. The system consists of two input functions and a single output function. Each function has its membership functions from which 49 inference rules of the system were formed. Three variables were considered in the course of this research. The variables are rainfall, land and rice production. Furthermore, linguistic variables were defined on each input. A rule based system was then formed which is defuzzified and a crisp value is obtained as the forecasted value. The result of this research shows that in 2022, 177950ha is required with 873mm of rainfall to produce 1070000TN of rice. Similarly, prediction is made of the required area, rainfall and rice yield up to 2030 in Jigawa state.</jats:p>
title: Forecasting rice production in Jigawa State,  Nigeria using fuzzy inference system

items.abstract: <jats:p>This article provides a systematic analysis of Abu Ali Ibn Sina’s (Avicenna’s) philosophical views on the concept of time, focusing on its ontological and epistemological dimensions. The study examines Ibn Sina’s interpretation of time as one of the fundamental forms of existence and as an objective measure of motion and change. Particular attention is paid to the relationship between time, space, motion, and the material world within his philosophical system. The article also explores the influence of Aristotle’s philosophy on Ibn Sina’s understanding of time, highlighting both the continuity and the distinctive features of his interpretation through a comparative analysis. Furthermore, the study evaluates the significance of Ibn Sina’s theory of time in the development of Islamic philosophy and its intellectual impact on later Eastern and Western philosophical traditions. The research is based on historical, comparative, logical, and hermeneutic methods, enabling a comprehensive examination of the concept of time in Ibn Sina’s works. The findings contribute to a deeper understanding of the philosophical essence of time in Ibn Sina’s legacy and enrich the theoretical foundations for contemporary philosophical studies on the nature of time.</jats:p>
title: ABU ALI IBN SINONING VAQT HAQIDAGI QARASHLARINING TAHLILI
AN ANALYSIS OF ABU ALI IBN SINA’S VIEWS ON TIME
АНАЛИЗ ВЗГЛЯДОВ АБУ АЛИ ИБН СИНЫ НА ВРЕМЯ

items.abstract: <jats:p>The regulation of firearms is a critical aspect of maintaining law and Order within any nation, and Nigeria is no exception. The Firearms Act CAP F28, enacted as part of the laws of the Federation of Nigeria in 2004, serves as the primary legal instrument governing the possession, use, and distribution of firearms. However, the application of this Act to members of the armed forces of Nigeria presents a unique set of challenges. These challenges stem from the distinct operational requirements, hierarchical structure, and legal status of military personnel. The armed forces, by their very nature, require access to firearms for the purpose of national defence, internal security, and the maintenance of peace. This necessitates a careful balance between ensuring that military personnel are adequately equipped to fulfil their duties and preventing the misuse or unauthorised proliferation of firearms. Understanding how the firearms Act is applied to this specific group is therefore crucial for promoting accountability, transparency, and adherence to the rule of law. This paper appraises the critical gap in understanding the practical application of the Firearms Act to the Armed Forces of the Federal Republic of Nigeria. Specifically, it investigates the extent to which the Act is enforced, the challenges encountered in its application, and the implication for both military operations and civilian safety. By appraising these issues, the paper seeks to contribute to a more informed and effective approach to firearms regulation within the military context.</jats:p>
title: APPRAISAL OF THE APPLICATION OF FIREARMS ACT ON MEMBERS OF THE ARMED FORCES OF NIGERIA

items.abstract: <jats:p>Traditional education is also known as customary education, whereas the blended mode of education includes e-learning tools and technology combined with teacher-centric traditional classrooms. To achieve better educational outcomes, it is crucial to consider the satisfaction level of students. This helps in enhancing understanding and enriching the learning process. This study aims to assess student satisfaction between these two modes. The study was conducted through a survey and cross-sectional research method, employing a quantitative research design. The data, randomly collected, comprised 110 respondents, with the majority being females and fewer being males. The collected data was analyzed using SPSS software, with regression and correlation tests performed. The results indicate that the blended mode of education had a significantly higher impact on student satisfaction compared to the traditional mode. This review highlights the vital role played by the blended mode of education in facilitating a better understanding of lessons for students. The use of digital technology in traditional classrooms makes lectures and concepts easier to comprehend for students. However, it is important to note that this study had limitations, and future researchers should explore additional factors for a more comprehensive understanding.</jats:p>
title: A Comparison of Student Satisfaction Between Traditional Mode of Education and Blended Teaching-Learning System
